instruction: I want to show notifications on the lock screen so I don't miss important alerts. Can you enable this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling notifications on lock screen. Evaluator verifies the show-notifications setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
